name: Sequester
summary: Hides an object or a willing creature from detection, leaving a creature in suspended animation.

m.text: gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

stats.effect:
With a touch, you magically sequester an object or a willing creature. For the duration, the target has the {ref:condition/invisible} condition and can't be targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic.

If the target is a creature, it enters a state of suspended animation; it has the {ref:condition/unconscious} condition, doesn't age, and doesn't need food, water, or air.

You can set a condition for the spell to end early. The condition can be anything you choose, but it must occur or be visible within 1 mile of the target. Examples include "after 1,000 years" or "when the tarrasque awakens." This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.
